svg.title: 31 · FDC / WH_Channel/Logic
svg.text: Native RLL · 108 source / 108 displayed rungs · full · AddOnInstructionDefinitions/WH_Channel/Routines/Logic · d498d2388efd56ddf147
ADDED · Pre: invalidate telemetry before any field changes. CaptureState: 0 init, 10 armed, 20 before captured, 30 published, 900 fault.
ADDED · New boot: reset capture evidence and the native TIMER. Common condition is evaluated before all seven branches.
ADDED · Invalid boot or changed installation latches capture fault 10.
ADDED · Compare all four installation words; this ordinary coil is recalculated each AOI invocation.
ADDED · 30 -> 10: accept only the matching durable event receipt.
ADDED · Resolve the permanent RF01/RF02 position index.
ADDED · RF01 base is 0; RF02 base is 96.
ADDED · Convert to the zero-based channel index.
ADDED · The selected removal item is the identity candidate. A stamp command alone does not publish a physical removal.
ADDED · Freeze the actual selected press with the candidate identity.
ADDED · Freeze the actual selected press with the candidate identity.
ADDED · One handled part across both furnaces; multiple other channels may reheat concurrently.
ADDED · Refresh the handled-part mailbox state after processing its durable receipt.
ADDED · A different return slot must wait until the owner event is durably acknowledged.
ADDED · A physical event may publish only into an armed, bounded channel mailbox.
ADDED · Invalidate the warning limit unless its complete per-slot load stamp and boot still match.
ADDED · Ignition publishes the calculated cycle-start limit for this boot and position.
ADDED · Compare all seven original-load timestamp fields; no abbreviated identity check.
ADDED · Accept the calculated limit only for the frozen owner load. This does not classify the part as wash heat.
ADDED · Map the existing item identity and accumulated qualifying soak without resetting the legacy timer.
ADDED · Map the existing item identity and accumulated qualifying soak without resetting the legacy timer.
ADDED · Map the existing item identity and accumulated qualifying soak without resetting the legacy timer.
ADDED · Map the existing item identity and accumulated qualifying soak without resetting the legacy timer.
ADDED · Map the existing item identity and accumulated qualifying soak without resetting the legacy timer.
ADDED · Recalculate live source quality every Pre scan.
ADDED · Identity and mapped signal links are available.
ADDED · A nonnegative retained soak counter and positive original maximum are required.
ADDED · Observe each HMI command edge once, before the legacy routine clears it.
ADDED · Keep the first pending decision timestamp while waiting for a durable receipt.
ADDED · CDL HMI observation: cmdValidate = Unload OK.
ADDED · CDL HMI observation: cmdCancelStamp = Unload Not OK/manual wash request.
ADDED · CDL HMI observation: cmdWashHeat = Unload Not OK/manual wash request.
ADDED · A cancelled stamp before CDL timing started releases the selection without inventing a wash event.
ADDED · Prioritize the actual CDL start before any later decision or cycle event.
ADDED · Publish the explicit operator decision first when both observations await receipt; arrival times are advisory.
ADDED · Cycle Start from the selected press closes the undecided/accepted transfer in Ignition.
ADDED · Observe the accepted door-closed wash load before legacy copy/clear.
ADDED · Latch return location/time and reset its stopwatch at the actual return scan.
ADDED · Run the native Post stopwatch immediately; return publication waits for two-furnace arbitration.
ADDED · Freeze the complete legacy-loaded return identity for later checks.
ADDED · Physical-return confirmation is the accepted wash load at the door-closed boundary, not the wash decision button.
ADDED · A new accepted return with an occupied mailbox is exposed as an overrun.
ADDED · Evaluate one physical-source publication gate before changing any flags.
ADDED · Bind the source event to the frozen full part/load identity; clear prior event flags before the sequence advances.
ADDED · Bind the source event to the frozen full part/load identity; clear prior event flags before the sequence advances.
ADDED · Bind the source event to the frozen full part/load identity; clear prior event flags before the sequence advances.
ADDED · Bind the source event to the frozen full part/load identity; clear prior event flags before the sequence advances.
ADDED · Bind the source event to the frozen full part/load identity; clear prior event flags before the sequence advances.
ADDED · Bind the source event to the frozen full part/load identity; clear prior event flags before the sequence advances.
ADDED · Removal time is the CDL timer start timestamp.
ADDED · Publish the operator observation; Ignition owns the state transition and conflict handling.
ADDED · Preserve FDC arrival time. A Cycle Start is advisory, not a measurement of material deformation.
ADDED · Retain a wash-request owner for physical return when the operator decision wins a near-simultaneous cycle observation.
ADDED · Return may use another segment in the same furnace; the original load identity is retained.
ADDED · Use the frozen accepted-return soak counter, not an older removal snapshot.
ADDED · Release handled-part capture after its terminal source event.
ADDED · Commit the next local physical sequence last; capture below freezes this complete frame.
ADDED · Correlate the running return stopwatch without resetting it after delayed publication.
ADDED · Prevent a later-scanned return slot from overtaking this newly published owner event.
ADDED · Rebuild the command observation mask before legacy item processing.
ADDED · Command observation 1: normal load; not physical proof.
ADDED · Command observation 2: wash load; not physical proof.
ADDED · Command observation 4: stamp; not physical proof.
ADDED · Command observation 8: wash command; not physical proof.
ADDED · Command observation 16: validate; not physical proof.
ADDED · Command observation 32: part-at-press command; not physical proof.
ADDED · Command observation 64: cancel; not physical proof.
ADDED · Command observation 128: reset/clear; not physical proof.
ADDED · Freeze the PLC-local physical source frame before legacy processing.
ADDED · Detect a newly published physical-source sequence.
ADDED · Source sequence exhaustion or invalid sequence latches fault 13.
ADDED · Calculate the next source sequence only within its bounded DINT range.
ADDED · A source sequence gap latches fault 13.
ADDED · Clear this invocation's capture request.
ADDED · Capture the source-mapped physical/operator event. Broadcast command bits alone are context, not 96 events.
ADDED · Remember this scan's command mask after evaluating the edge.
ADDED · An event arriving outside armed state 10 latches overrun fault 11; frozen evidence survives.
ADDED · Bound the event counter before any publication increment.
ADDED · Evaluate capture admission once. This real BOOL coil powers every following before-snapshot rung.
ADDED · Freeze before payload, ordered branches 1-4. Sequence stays zero; final branch changes 10 -> 20.
ADDED · Freeze before payload, ordered branches 5-8. Sequence stays zero; final branch changes 10 -> 20.
ADDED · Freeze before payload, ordered branches 9-12. Sequence stays zero; final branch changes 10 -> 20.
ADDED · Freeze before payload, ordered branches 13-15. Sequence stays zero; final branch changes 10 -> 20.
ADDED · For mapped returns retain the complete item frozen immediately after the actual accepted-load scan.
ADDED · Physical return: reset the native TIMER and enter TimerState 10 before its single Post-rung RTO execution.
ADDED · Conflicting return/removal facts invalidate the timer; Ignition owns disposition.
ADDED · Remember the consumed physical-source sequence after its checks.
ADDED · Post: the dispatch RTO has already executed once; sample its millisecond accumulator.
ADDED · Physical removal: 10 -> 20 after measuring the removal scan; retain elapsed value.
ADDED · Native timer completion/exhaustion or invalid accumulator latches timer fault 21.
ADDED · Evaluate publication once, before changing CaptureState; no jump or label is required.
ADDED · Freeze the post-legacy item and measured timer in the same event.
ADDED · 20 -> 30: increment the bounded event counter and commit Event.Sequence LAST.
ADDED · Any latched technical fault enters state 900 and invalidates timer status.
ADDED · Publish raw current telemetry, ordered branches 1-4; business rules execute in Ignition.
ADDED · Publish raw current telemetry, ordered branches 5-8; business rules execute in Ignition.
ADDED · Publish raw current telemetry, ordered branches 9-12; business rules execute in Ignition.
ADDED · Publish raw current telemetry, ordered branches 13-16; business rules execute in Ignition.
ADDED · Publish raw current telemetry, ordered branches 17-20; business rules execute in Ignition.
ADDED · Publish raw current telemetry, ordered branches 21-22; business rules execute in Ignition.
ADDED · Clear raw DINT item flags before sampling the legacy BOOL values.
ADDED · Copy raw legacy flag stsEmpty.
ADDED · Copy raw legacy flag stsStamped.
ADDED · Copy raw legacy flag stsWashHeat.
ADDED · Wrap only the live-sample counter within its channel epoch.
ADDED · Commit positive SampleSequence LAST, after all telemetry updates.
SOURCE · original PLC storage / Item InOut
Blue = original. Red = fault + nonzero code; fault 0 = neutral. Yellow = state + value. GUTTER = group / qualifier; INIT is a label only.
